assets.label: room
assets.prompt: Create a finished usable 2D mobile pet game BACKGROUND, a cozy small shared bedroom for cute animals. Square canvas. Extremely clean simple drawing, thin cocoa-brown outlines, flat pastel solid colors, warm off-white walls and honey pale wood floor, no realistic 3D lighting, no fine texture. Front-facing view with a little floor depth, storybook dollhouse. At TOP THIRD: a small arched window with blue sky and two simple green trees outside, short sage curtains, a small wall shelf with two books and one plant on left, a tiny warm bedside lamp on right. At MIDDLE: two low soft beds tucked against rear wall at far left and far right, a small blanket, spare cushions. Most important: bottom 60 percent is EMPTY broad soft oval cream and peach rug on the floor, clear playable staging space for three separately composited animal sprites. Furniture must not occupy center or foreground. Cheerful, breathable, warm and quiet, very restrained detail. NO animals, NO humans, NO characters, NO words, NO numbers, NO UI, NO logos, NO framed scene within the canvas. Full-bleed background. Match reference pets' flat 2D illustration simplicity and warm colors.

assets.label: actions
assets.prompt: Create six simple friendly 2D mobile pet game action icons on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Equal 3 columns by 2 rows, square cells, one isolated centered icon each, empty 20 percent margin in every cell. Overall wide 3:2 canvas. Clean thin cocoa outline, entirely flat pastel colors, soft round shapes, NO highlights, gradients, glow, shadow, text, labels, badges, frames or background. Each icon legible at 36 pixels. Row one: 1 a single rounded mitten hand with a tiny peach heart next to it (petting); 2 a small sage food bowl with three simple biscuit circles (feed); 3 one peach-and-sky striped toy ball (play). Row two: 4 a small folded lavender blanket with crescent yellow moon above it (bedtime); 5 a tiny cream home with peach roof and one pink heart on door (adopt); 6 a closed pale mint notebook with one simple paw print (pet friends). Same stroke weight throughout. No animal faces. These are production UI icons to put above Korean text labels in app. Objects only and fully transparent outside.

assets.label: 12종 초기 비교 시안
assets.prompt: Refine this original 12-animal lineup into an EXTREMELY SIMPLE, calm, cute 2D game mascot art direction. Preserve exactly these 12 species, their individual identities, their grid order, and varied silhouettes, but reduce visual detail by roughly 70%. Enlarge soft round shapes and shorten limbs a little. The main goal is very economical friendly line work, like understated Japanese small-animal doodle mascots with expressive family-animation poses. Outline must be a single thin, clean, consistent dark-brown line, NOT thick sticker outlines. Every animal only 2-3 completely FLAT solid color fills. White clean background. NO gradients, NO texture, NO watercolor, NO paper grain, NO cast shadows or shading, NO gleams, NO realistic fur. Remove whiskers, eyebrows, toe/finger divisions, random skin spots, and extra fur tufts. Hedgehog back has just six round scallops with no internal spine lines. Tortoise has three simple shell panels. Red panda tail only three broad bands. Tiny black oval eyes and a very small mouth; one tiny peach cheek on each side is allowed. Happy relaxed expressions. Animals should look handmade and lovable, not generic vector stock art, not baby clipart. All twelve fully visible, evenly sized on a 4-column by 3-row sheet, generous margins, no text, no UI, no numbers. Distinct original character designs, not existing franchise characters.
